bifrost: springboard/src/media/ (mod.rs, demux/, hwdec/, queue.rs, player.rs, mp4.rs, alsa.rs, audiod/)
summary: Core Media's low-level types (sample and block buffers, CMTime, clocks and timebases, buffer queues, format descriptions) have no app-facing BifrOSt SDK equivalent. The media pipeline has internal counterparts for samples, a playback clock, frame queues, a video decoder seam and audio output, but they are owned by the media modules and the audio service rather than exposed to apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/demux/mod.rs:89 (Sample: track, pts_us, dts_us, duration_us, keyframe, data); springboard/src/media/mp4.rs:46 (Sample)
features.note: Samples are owned Vec<u8> values. No shared buffer object, no data-ready callbacks, no invalidation, no sample attachments.

Wave 4 (theme-06, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No general block-buffer type. The DMA buffer trait covers only GPU-shared picture memory, not CPU-side sample storage.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/mp4.rs:17 (Codec); springboard/src/media/mod.rs:101 (Codec); springboard/src/media/mod.rs:226 (VideoDecoder::configure takes codec and raw avcC/hvcC extradata)
features.note: Codec identity and parameter-set bytes are passed around as enum plus raw bytes. No format description object with dimensions, pixel aspect ratio, clean aperture or audio stream description.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/demux/mod.rs:89 (i64 microseconds); springboard/src/media/mp4.rs:46 (f64 milliseconds); springboard/src/media/player.rs:47 (Clock, f64 ms)
features.note: Two internal units (microseconds in the demuxer, milliseconds in the mp4 sample and player clock). No rational time, no timescale conversion, no invalid or indefinite values, no time ranges type for apps.

features.apple: CMClock, CMAudioClock, CMTimebase (rate, anchor time, timers, time-jump notifications) (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmclock)
features.note: Wave 5 (w5-core-media, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The audio thread owns the playback clock and the audio service publishes position. No timebase with rate and effective rate, no timers on a timeline, no host-time conversion, no genlock or device-drift queries.

features.apple: CMBufferQueue (enqueue, dequeue, triggers, timestamp bounds), CMSimpleQueue (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmbufferqueue)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/queue.rs; springboard/src/media/demux/mse.rs:59 (Queue, sorted by dts with a cursor)
features.note: Internal queues for the pipeline and for an MSE-style source buffer. No triggers, no data-ready gating, no validation handler, and not exposed as an SDK type.

Wave 4 (theme-06, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No pooled allocator for large media blocks. Frames are allocated per picture.

features.feature: Video decoding and picture hand-off (image buffers)
features.apple: CMSampleBuffer image buffer path, CMSampleBufferGetImageBuffer, CMVideoFormatDescription matching (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmsamplebuffer-api)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/media/mod.rs:226 (VideoDecoder trait); springboard/src/media/mod.rs:212 (Frame with pts_us and pixels); springboard/src/media/mod.rs:173 (VideoLayer for the GPU); springboard/src/media/hwdec/ffmpeg.rs; springboard/src/media/hwdec/vaapi.rs
features.note: Hardware decode through libavcodec and VA-API on the DRM render node, with software fallback. Decoded pictures reach the shell as VideoLayer. The player is used by the Deildu app; no SDK API for apps.
AAC-LC decode and conversion to 48 kHz stereo S16. Packet descriptions and PCM copy into an AudioBufferList equivalent are not exposed. Codec coverage is AAC-only in the audio path.
Output goes through ALSA's default PCM so PipeWire or PulseAudio can mix. Apps reach it through the audio service, not through a media API.
V4L2 capture for the camera. No SDK sample-buffer type for apps.

features.apple: CMMetadata, CMTag, CMTagCollection, metadata identifiers and data-type registry (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmmetadata)
features.note: ID3 and iTunes-style tag readers exist. No metadata identifier or key-space registry, no tag collections, no typed tags.

features.apple: CMTextMarkup attribute keys (font, style, colour, layout) (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia/cmtextmarkup)
features.note: Wave 4 (w4-core-media, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No caption or subtitle styling model was found. springboard/src/media/demux/webm.rs was not inspected for subtitle track handling.
Stereo and projected video formats are not part of the BifrOSt desktop media scope. Camera capture is V4L2 only.

Wave 4 (theme-06, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No per-sample attachments such as not-sync or dropped-frame reasons. Pipeline errors go through Result values, not notifications.

gaps: No app-facing SDK API for media samples, timing or clocks. Apps reach playback only through the audio service and the media modules.
No rational CMTime-style time type with timescale conversion, invalid and indefinite values, or time ranges.
No timebase with rate control and timers, so apps cannot drive a timeline with a rate or time jumps.
No general block buffer or memory pool for CPU-side sample data.
No text markup model for captions and subtitles.
No per-sample attachments or sample buffer notifications.
